SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND
INITSECTION
// GENERATED by scripts/dialogs/build.py from scripts/dialogs/scenes/ch*.py (chapter(...)).
// Do not edit: change the chapter declaration and rebuild. See scripts/dialogs/README.md.
// Alfira's conversation chapters (design/APPROVAL.md section 4): one new chapter at a time, in order;
// optional chapters whose story condition is not met do not hold the queue.
// ALFSV_ChapterNN_Available is set here, ALFSV_ChapterNN_Done by the chapter dialog itself.
// A save made before chapters existed (Alfira already recruited): the goal is new there, so this
// INIT runs on story patching and opens the chapters that do not wait for a rest.
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);
KBSECTION
//REGION When to look for a new chapter

// After every long rest (GLO_Camp.txt: PROC_Camp_EveryoneAwake -> PROC_LongRest)
PROC
PROC_LongRest()
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(1);

// Chapters that do not wait for a rest: at recruitment and when a chapter has been played
IF
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);

IF
FlagSet((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Done_646b75d3-e9b5-5022-ada3-b3388118c998, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);

IF
FlagSet((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Done_4cd365b4-313e-536b-969f-84319fa4cbb6, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);

IF
FlagSet((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Done_e36eef66-be91-5d11-bbb3-258f164c1005, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);

IF
FlagSet((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Done_628434fd-747c-5041-87a3-fdbea040a950, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);

// Chapter 4 does not wait for a rest: its story event opens it
IF
FlagSet((FLAG)ALFSV_Celebration_Tonight_286ff093-d8b0-584d-9e8d-7c92853e9b5c, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);

// A new level (e.g. the next act): act-bound chapters stop waiting
IF
LevelGameplayStarted(_, _)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(0);

// Debug (Script Extender console): Osi.PROC_ALFSV_Debug_UnlockChapter() - as if a long rest had passed
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Debug_UnlockChapter()
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock(1);

//END_REGION

//REGION Queue: a chapter is waiting (unlocked, not played yet)

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Available_c5a9450f-9f12-54bf-af68-396d3813a270)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Done_646b75d3-e9b5-5022-ada3-b3388118c998)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Available_b8ac2941-38e0-5c94-8fc1-4dec55aa4d2d)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Done_4cd365b4-313e-536b-969f-84319fa4cbb6)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Available_019959fe-9b91-5a1f-8a41-1dcd03c8ab8f)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Done_e36eef66-be91-5d11-bbb3-258f164c1005)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Available_98012add-a301-57d3-91a7-653224520ec9)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Done_628434fd-747c-5041-87a3-fdbea040a950)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

//END_REGION

//REGION Acts (DB_CurrentLevel; levels per act - scripts/dialogs/dsl.py ACT_LEVELS)

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_InAct((INTEGER)_Act)
AND
_Act == 1
AND
DB_CurrentLevel("WLD_Main_A")
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_InAct((INTEGER)_Act)
AND
_Act == 1
AND
DB_CurrentLevel("CRE_Main_A")
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

//END_REGION

//REGION Chapters

// Chapter 3: any of these story events
QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapter03_StoryAny()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)GOB_State_LeadersAreDead_a1c5b01f-4b7f-47ab-82b0-d24d9c6d8bc6)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapter03_StoryAny()
AND
QuestUpdateIsUnlocked(NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, "HAG_HagSpawn", "SavedMayrina", 1)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

QRY
QRY_ALFSV_Chapter03_StoryAny()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)DEN_AttackOnDen_State_DenVictory_71c7f23e-3ff1-c9b8-3ef5-d75fa1b42c8d)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

// Chapter 3 is bound to act 1: unlocked but not played before the act ended - it no longer waits
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock((INTEGER)_AtRest)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Available_019959fe-9b91-5a1f-8a41-1dcd03c8ab8f)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Done_e36eef66-be91-5d11-bbb3-258f164c1005)
AND
NOT QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_InAct(1)
THEN
PROC_GlobalClearFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Available_019959fe-9b91-5a1f-8a41-1dcd03c8ab8f);

// Chapter 4 is bound to act 1: unlocked but not played before the act ended - it no longer waits
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock((INTEGER)_AtRest)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Available_98012add-a301-57d3-91a7-653224520ec9)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Done_628434fd-747c-5041-87a3-fdbea040a950)
AND
NOT QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_InAct(1)
THEN
PROC_GlobalClearFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Available_98012add-a301-57d3-91a7-653224520ec9);

// Chapter 4 expires: its story flag is cleared before it was played
IF
FlagCleared((FLAG)ALFSV_Celebration_Tonight_286ff093-d8b0-584d-9e8d-7c92853e9b5c, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, _)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Available_98012add-a301-57d3-91a7-653224520ec9)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Done_628434fd-747c-5041-87a3-fdbea040a950)
THEN
PROC_GlobalClearFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Available_98012add-a301-57d3-91a7-653224520ec9);

// Chapter 1: ALFSV_Alfira_Ch01_FirstNight - unlocks immediately
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock((INTEGER)_AtRest)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Available_c5a9450f-9f12-54bf-af68-396d3813a270)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Done_646b75d3-e9b5-5022-ada3-b3388118c998)
AND
NOT QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
THEN
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Available_c5a9450f-9f12-54bf-af68-396d3813a270);

// Chapter 2: ALFSV_Alfira_Ch02_Lute - unlocks after a long rest, after chapter 1
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock((INTEGER)_AtRest)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Available_b8ac2941-38e0-5c94-8fc1-4dec55aa4d2d)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Done_4cd365b4-313e-536b-969f-84319fa4cbb6)
AND
NOT QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Done_646b75d3-e9b5-5022-ada3-b3388118c998)
AND
_AtRest == 1
THEN
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Available_b8ac2941-38e0-5c94-8fc1-4dec55aa4d2d);

// Chapter 3: ALFSV_Alfira_Ch03_FirstVerse - optional, unlocks after a long rest, after chapters 1, 2, only in act 1
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock((INTEGER)_AtRest)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Available_019959fe-9b91-5a1f-8a41-1dcd03c8ab8f)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Done_e36eef66-be91-5d11-bbb3-258f164c1005)
AND
NOT QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Done_646b75d3-e9b5-5022-ada3-b3388118c998)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Done_4cd365b4-313e-536b-969f-84319fa4cbb6)
AND
_AtRest == 1
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Chapter03_StoryAny()
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_InAct(1)
THEN
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter03_Available_019959fe-9b91-5a1f-8a41-1dcd03c8ab8f);

// Chapter 4: ALFSV_Alfira_Ch04_Celebration - optional, unlocks immediately, after chapters 1, 2, only in act 1
PROC
PROC_ALFSV_Chapters_Unlock((INTEGER)_AtRest)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Available_98012add-a301-57d3-91a7-653224520ec9)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Done_628434fd-747c-5041-87a3-fdbea040a950)
AND
NOT QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_Waiting()
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter01_Done_646b75d3-e9b5-5022-ada3-b3388118c998)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter02_Done_4cd365b4-313e-536b-969f-84319fa4cbb6)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ALFSV_Celebration_Tonight_286ff093-d8b0-584d-9e8d-7c92853e9b5c)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_InAct(1)
THEN
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache((FLAG)ALFSV_Chapter04_Available_98012add-a301-57d3-91a7-653224520ec9);

//END_REGION
EXITSECTION
